description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlement entity class for the OrangeHRM project, representing leave entitlement records in the database with ORM mapping, properties, and accessor methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Entity class representing leave entitlement for an employee, including properties like days, date range, type, and relations to other entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this leave entitlement.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with this leave entitlement.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of leave days allocated.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of leave days allocated.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used from the entitlement.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type for this entitlement.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the entitlement was credited.

methods.name: setCreditedDate
methods.description: Sets the credited date.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for this entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlementType
methods.description: Returns the type of entitlement.

methods.name: setEntitlementType
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the record is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the record as deleted or not.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who created this record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who created this record.
